about: Hand-curated venue research for ICISA, keyed by the code its programme-pdf adapter gives the conference hotel, with the halls its programme grid names. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and their source.

david-intercontinental.name: The David InterContinental Hotel Tel Aviv
david-intercontinental.notes: On-site parking at the hotel, first come first served, at a discounted daily fee with the conference's parking-card encoder (the venue page).
